name: Omnisend
description_en:
Omnisend is an ecommerce email, SMS and web-push marketing platform. Automation workflows use store/customer events or segment transitions to start sequences with delays, messages and splits. Its practical value depends on which events and identifiers the store integration supplies, not merely whether a preset is visible.

Admission, channel eligibility and ongoing exit rules are separate decisions. An identified visitor can enter a browse flow yet lack eligibility for one message channel; a segment trigger can identify an audience but does not carry order details. This profile follows those distinctions through repeated entry, live editing and reporting, using current official guides without an account or sending test.
description_zh:
Omnisend 是面向电商的邮件、短信及网页推送营销平台。自动化流程通过商店／客户事件或分群变化启动包含延迟、消息及分支的序列。实际价值取决于商店集成提供的事件与身份，不能仅据预设可见判断。

准入、渠道发送资格及持续退出规则是不同决策。已识别访客可进入浏览流程，但不具备某个消息渠道的资格；分群入口可识别受众，却不携带订单详情。本文依据当前官方指南追踪这些区别，以及重复加入、活动编辑和报告，未进行账户或发送测试。

core_features.explanation_en: Order-based triggers carry event-specific data used in messages and filters.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订单类入口携带可用于消息及筛选的事件数据。

core_features.explanation_en: Frequency uses past entry time and remains tied to trigger history through edits.
core_features.explanation_zh: Frequency 使用历史加入时间，编辑后仍与触发历史关联。

core_features.explanation_en: Skip Contacts checks selected other workflows separately from same-flow Frequency.
core_features.explanation_zh: Skip Contacts 检查指定其他流程，与同流程 Frequency 分开。

core_features.explanation_en: Per-channel subscription status determines which messages a contact can receive.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分渠道订阅状态决定联系人可接收哪些消息。

en: Editorial fit: ecommerce lifecycle teams with a supported store integration and identifiable visitors.
Editorial fit: operators coordinating welcome, post-purchase and abandonment messages across eligible channels.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：具备支持的商店集成及可识别访客的电商生命周期团队。
编辑判断的适用场景：通过合格渠道协调欢迎、购买后及放弃消息的运营人员。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Inspect an event payload and choose event versus segment entry based on required personalization.
steps.zh: 检查事件载荷，按个性化需要选择事件或分群入口。

steps.en: Set recurrence, cross-workflow skip rules and prospective exits before the internal cohort enters.
steps.zh: 内部群体加入前设置重复、跨流程跳过及向后生效的退出规则。

steps.en: Check per-channel statuses, tracking identity and Trigger Preview outcomes.
steps.zh: 检查分渠道状态、跟踪身份及 Trigger Preview 结果。

steps.en: Publish then activate a narrowly scoped test; preserve report evidence before editing or deletion.
steps.zh: 发布后启用小范围测试；编辑或删除前保留报告证据。

items.en: Adding an exit condition cannot retroactively govern contacts already in the workflow.
items.zh: 新增退出条件不能追溯约束流程已有联系人。

items.en: Setup describes an approximately 15-second segment check wait while trigger guidance also recommends delayed splits; exact refresh behavior is not measured and a later delay cannot be assumed to repair failed admission.
items.zh: 设置页描述约 15 秒分群检查等待，入口指南也建议延迟分支；未测量准确刷新行为，不能假设后续延迟可修复已失败准入。

items.en: General retries, duplicate event handling, pause/resume clocks and recall remain unverified.
items.zh: 一般重试、重复事件处理、暂停／恢复时钟及撤回仍未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current Free card: $0, up to 250 contacts, 500 emails and 500 web push notifications monthly. USD calculator shows a three-month-upfront 30% offer: Standard $11.20/mo, $33.60 today, 500 contacts/6,000 emails; Pro $41.30/mo, $123.90 today, 2,500 contacts. These are displayed promotional states, not normalized permanent prices. Standard emails are 12× list size; Pro fair use is up to 60×. Billable count includes subscribers and non-subscribers receiving automation, not unsubscribed contacts. SMS costs extra and varies by country/volume. Confirm renewal and actual billable tier.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前 Free 卡：$0，每月最多 250 联系人、500 邮件及 500 网页推送。美元计算器展示三个月预付七折：Standard $11.20／月、当日 $33.60，500 联系人／6,000 邮件；Pro $41.30／月、当日 $123.90，2,500 联系人。这些是显示的促销状态，不生成永久标准价。Standard 邮件为列表数 12 倍；Pro 公平用量最多 60 倍。计费人数包括订阅者及收到自动消息的未订阅者，不含已退订者。短信额外计费，随国家／数量变化。应确认续费及真实计费档位。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Choose an event that supplies the required message data
sections.title_zh: 选择能提供所需消息数据的事件
sections.en: Placed Order and Paid for Order carry order, billing and shipping details; Ordered Product instead focuses on product properties. Segment entry/exit triggers do not carry purchase data, so an order number or billing-address variable can be empty even when the audience is correct. For an editorial post-purchase pilot, inspect the actual incoming event and sample personalization before sending. Trigger Preview examines the last ten events and filter outcomes; that diagnostic is not evidence that a message rendered or reached an inbox.
sections.zh: Placed Order 及 Paid for Order 携带订单、账单及配送详情，Ordered Product 则侧重产品属性。分群加入／退出入口不携带购买数据，因此即使受众正确，订单号或账单地址变量也可能为空。编辑示例：购买后试点应在发送前检查真实入站事件和个性化示例。Trigger Preview 查看最近十个事件及筛选结果；此诊断不能证明消息已渲染或送达收件箱。

sections.title_en: Historical segment admission is a first-activation choice
sections.title_zh: 历史分群加入是首次启用选择
sections.en: By default, segment transitions after activation trigger the workflow. Including people already in the segment requires a checkbox on a workflow that has never been enabled; later pausing or disabling does not restore that option. The guide offers duplication as a separate workflow, not a replay guarantee for the old one. For a historical cohort, inspect the confirmation count and restrict the pilot audience before activation. Editing segment rules can also create new transitions, so preserve a meaningful recurrence rule rather than assuming static membership.
sections.zh: 默认由启用后的分群变化触发流程。加入分群已有人员，需要在从未启用的流程中勾选选项；之后暂停或停用不会恢复该选项。指南提供复制为另一个流程的方法，不能视为旧流程重放保证。历史群体应在启用前检查确认人数并限制试点受众。编辑分群规则也可能产生新变化，因此应设置有意义的重复规则，不能假设成员关系静止不变。

sections.title_en: Entry time governs recurrence, even during a long journey
sections.title_zh: 即使旅程很长，重复仍从加入时计时
sections.en: Frequency disabled allows repeat triggers; At any time in the past means once ever, not unrestricted entry. A timed frequency starts at entry rather than exit, so a journey longer than that interval can overlap with a later trip. Editing does not reset trigger history. For a welcome sequence, explicitly choose once-ever behavior; for recurring reminders, compare the full delay duration with the intended repeat interval. Frequency controls this workflow, while Skip Contacts checks selected other workflows.
sections.zh: 关闭 Frequency 允许重复触发；At any time in the past 表示永久一次，并非不限次数。定时频率从加入而非退出开始，因此旅程长于该间隔时，可能与后一次旅程重叠。编辑不会重置触发历史。欢迎序列应明确选择永久一次；重复提醒应比较全部延迟与目标重复间隔。Frequency 控制当前流程，Skip Contacts 则检查指定其他流程。

sections.title_en: A known email is insufficient for browse abandonment
sections.title_zh: 已知邮箱不足以触发浏览放弃
sections.en: Browse Abandonment requires an email-linked browser tracking cookie created through documented identification actions such as a form, email-link click or checkout email. A stored address alone is insufficient, and this workflow cannot be triggered retrospectively. Unlike product/cart flows, it does not supply viewed product details or a dynamic return URL for the page. For an editorial collection-page reminder, test an identified internal browser and use a deliberate collection link rather than inventing an event URL variable.
sections.zh: Browse Abandonment 需要与邮箱关联的浏览器跟踪 cookie，由表单、邮件链接点击或结账邮箱等文档识别动作创建。只有已存邮箱不足以触发，且此流程不能追溯触发。它不同于产品／购物车流程，不提供浏览产品详情或页面动态返回 URL。编辑示例：集合页提醒应使用已识别内部浏览器测试，并明确链接集合页，不能虚构事件 URL 变量。

sections.title_en: Abandonment stages need explicit handoff rules
sections.title_zh: 放弃流程各阶段需要明确交接规则
sections.en: There is no built-in workflow priority selector. The guide combines exit events for progression through the shopping funnel with Skip Contacts rules covering active or recently completed workflows. It also says mutual suppression gives precedence to whichever flow is entered first; that is not guaranteed automatic preemption by checkout. Map which flow blocks which other flow and test a contact moving from browsing to cart to checkout. A default purchase exit alone does not establish that every overlapping journey has already stopped.
sections.zh: 平台没有内置流程优先级选择器。指南结合购物漏斗后续事件作为退出条件，以及检查活动／近期完成流程的 Skip Contacts 规则。它还说相互抑制使最先进入的流程优先，这不能保证结账流程自动抢占。应明确哪个流程阻止哪个流程，并测试浏览到购物车再到结账的联系人。默认购买退出条件本身不能证明所有重叠旅程都已停止。

sections.title_en: Exit changes are prospective and channel eligibility is separate
sections.title_zh: 退出修改仅向后生效，渠道资格单独控制
sections.en: Audience filters check at entry; exit conditions monitor later events but new/changed exits apply only to contacts entering afterward. The guide cannot selectively remove an already-active contact unless a suitable exit was set up before entry, and describes exiting all current contacts as a broader operation. Independently, Workflow Channel Settings selects eligible subscription states. Custom-event flows default to all contacts, including unsubscribed contacts, so inspect that setting explicitly for each channel. The technical option to select a status does not establish permission to send particular content.
sections.zh: 受众筛选在加入时检查；退出条件监测后续事件，但新增／修改退出仅适用于之后加入者。指南不能选择性移出已有活动联系人，除非加入前已设合适退出规则；退出所有当前联系人是更广泛操作。Workflow Channel Settings 另行选择可发送订阅状态。自定义事件流程默认包括已退订在内的全部联系人，因此应逐渠道明确检查。技术上能选择某种状态，不能证明有权发送特定内容。

sections.title_en: Publication, activation and in-flight changes have separate effects
sections.title_zh: 发布、启用及进行中修改影响不同
sections.en: The setup guide requires both Publish Changes and activation; activation without publication runs the old version. The live-edit guide lets existing contacts finish their original structure or exit immediately; newly added steps do not automatically reach old or completed contacts. Content edits can apply to existing contacts according to setup guidance. Delays run from the previous block’s end and use the store timezone, not campaign Time Zone Optimization. Before changing an enabled flow, record current occupancy and the intended handling choice; no pause-clock or message-recall guarantee was verified.
sections.zh: 设置指南要求 Publish Changes 及启用两步；未发布直接启用会运行旧版。活动编辑指南允许已有联系人完成原结构或立即退出；新增步骤不会自动覆盖旧联系人或已完成者。设置指南说内容编辑可应用于已有联系人。延迟从上一块结束计时，使用商店时区，不能使用群发的 Time Zone Optimization。修改已启用流程前应记录当前人数及处理选择；未核实暂停时钟或消息撤回保证。

sections.title_en: A zero block count can reflect an edit, not failed entry
sections.title_zh: 区块零计数可能来自编辑而非加入失败
sections.en: Automation reports separate triggered, completed, exited and currently active contacts. Skipped at a message block can reflect channel status; continuing requires the block’s pass-to-next-step option. Adding or editing a message block resets its counter, and the editor defaults to a 30-day report window. Workflow deletion also deletes its report. Preserve relevant evidence before deletion, compare the same time window and inspect contact activity before concluding that a new block’s zeros mean no one entered the workflow.
sections.zh: 自动化报告区分触发、完成、退出及当前活动联系人。消息块 Skipped 可能来自渠道状态；继续需启用该块跳至下一步选项。添加或编辑消息块会重置其计数，编辑器默认报告窗口为 30 天。删除流程还会删除报告。删除前应保存相关证据、统一时间窗口并检查联系人活动，再把新块零计数判断为无人加入流程。

seo.title_en: Omnisend automation: triggers, repeat entry and live edits
seo.title_zh: Omnisend 自动化：入口、重复加入与活动编辑
seo.description_en: Evaluate Omnisend event data, segment backfill, browse tracking, overlap controls, exit limits and promotional pricing conditions.
seo.description_zh: 评估 Omnisend 事件数据、历史分群加入、浏览跟踪、重叠控制、退出限制及促销价条件。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Omnisend ecommerce workflow behavior and operational limits
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No store connection, cookie test, import, automation activation, purchase or message sending performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未连接商店、测试 cookie、导入、启用自动化、购买或发送消息。

research_gaps.en: Exact account-specific tracking, integration payload, segment freshness, retry, pause and recall behavior remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体账户跟踪、集成载荷、分群新鲜度、重试、暂停及撤回行为未核实。

research_gaps.en: Current UI languages, regional eligibility, self-hosting rights and exact renewal contract were not established.
research_gaps.zh: 未确认当前界面语言、地区资格、自托管权利及准确续费合同。
